notes.title: New Demo Update and Development Sneak Peeks
notes.notes:
Hey Mushroom Kids! 

We're back with some exciting updates on the game!
🍄 New Demo Update
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799254/a2142fc0fd7b271bf56b3339052445ce8e8d96de.gif"]

We’ve uploaded a brand-new demo build! This version includes updated movement mechanics and minor tweaks to menus, save points, and more.



If you’ve got time, please check it out and let us know what you think! Your feedback is super helpful and appreciated. The best place to drop that feedback is in our awesome Discord community ;)

👉 https://discord.gg/fFDS54vaYE
✨ Sneak Peek - The Heart of the Land
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799254/f4682dfcd92d24c8d9c7b3af3ac9a0855cc6883c.gif"]

While it’s still a work-in-progress, we’d like to share a little teaser of the next area in our game being the Heart of the Land. A mysterious mechanical structure filled with rusted icy machinery. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799254/7b66e5a28ec828bb4224bc6fc23786cc074e8926.gif"]

Here, Mica must slide through treacherous chambers lined with jagged metal and machinery. We have a couple of fun mechanics that we can’t wait to showcase when the full game is out.
